backswing_s.label: Backswing time
backswing_s.meaning: Time from address to the top of the swing.
downswing_s.label: Downswing time
downswing_s.meaning: Time from the top of the swing to impact.
tempo_ratio.label: Tempo
tempo_ratio.meaning: Backswing time divided by downswing time.
tempo_ratio.range: Most good players are close to 3.0
head_sway_x_m.label: Head sway
head_sway_x_m.meaning: How far your head moves along the target line during the swing.
head_sway_x_m.range: Smaller is steadier; within about 5 cm
head_lift_z_m.label: Head lift
head_lift_z_m.meaning: How far your head rises or drops during the swing.
head_depth_y_m.label: Head depth
head_depth_y_m.meaning: How far your head moves toward or away from the ball.
spine_forward_tilt_deg.label: Spine tilt (forward)
spine_forward_tilt_deg.meaning: How far your upper body bends forward at address.
spine_side_tilt_deg.label: Spine tilt (side)
spine_side_tilt_deg.meaning: How far your upper body leans to the side at address.
shoulder_turn_deg.label: Shoulder turn
shoulder_turn_deg.meaning: How far your shoulders turn at the top.
hip_turn_deg.label: Hip turn
hip_turn_deg.meaning: How far your hips turn at the top.
x_factor_deg.label: X-factor
hand_plane_dev_m.label: Hand plane deviation
hand_plane_dev_m.meaning: How far your hands move off the shaft plane.
top_shaft_angle_deg.label: Shaft at the top
top_shaft_angle_deg.meaning: Direction of the shaft at the top of the swing.
top_shaft_angle_deg.range: Close to parallel to the target line
weight_shift_pct.label: Weight shift
weight_shift_pct.meaning: Pelvis movement as a share of your stance width (estimate).
weight_shift_pct.range: Moves toward the lead foot by impact
early_extension_m.label: Early extension
early_extension_m.meaning: How far your pelvis moves toward the ball in the downswing.
club_speed_mps.label: Club speed
club_speed_mps.meaning: Speed of the club head at impact.
club_path_deg.label: Club path
club_path_deg.meaning: In-to-out (positive) or out-to-in (negative) direction of the club at impact.
ball_speed_mps.label: Ball speed
ball_speed_mps.meaning: Speed of the ball as it leaves the club face.
launch_v_deg.label: Launch angle
launch_v_deg.meaning: Vertical angle at which the ball takes off.
launch_h_deg.label: Start direction
launch_h_deg.meaning: Left or right direction in which the ball starts.
carry_m.label: Carry
carry_m.meaning: Distance the ball flies through the air (no roll).
smash_factor.label: Smash factor
smash_factor.meaning: Ball speed divided by club speed.
